name: Zimone's Hypothesis
oracle_text: You may put a +1/+1 counter on a creature. Then choose odd or even. Return each creature with power of the chosen quality to its owner's hand. (Zero is even.)
blocked_sentences: Then choose odd or even. Return each creature with power of the chosen quality to its owner's hand. (Zero is even.)

needs.what: a selector comparison on a creature's live power (and, for sibling cards, mana value) that matches by parity -- e.g. power: {"parity": "odd"|"even"} with zero even, or {"parity": {"binding": "chosen"}} reading a resolution-time 'choose odd or even' decision
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The selector `power` key goes through selectors._compare, which only knows >=, <=, >, <, ==, != against a value; parity exists only for die rolls (`rolled` with `parity` in values.py). A choose_mode with an any_of list of power == 0, 2, 4 ... would be a finite approximation of an unbounded set.
